FROZEN INVENTORY OF THE BLADE ACCESSIBLE FRONTEND. Do not regenerate — the
source it describes was deleted on 2026-08-14.

Why this file exists: generate-accessible-route-matrix.js compared web-uk
against the live Blade route files. With those gone the generator silently
produced laravelRoutes: 0, which made the drift check impossible to pass and,
worse, would have reported every lost web-uk route as "no Laravel route to
match" instead of as a regression.

Captured from the last matrix generated while Blade still existed
(2026-08-13T15:14:54.537Z, 707 Laravel routes, 707 matched, 0 missing). It is
now a REGRESSION baseline: a web-uk route that disappears shows up as
"missing" against what the accessible frontend served on the day Blade was
retired. Rows may be removed only with a recorded reason.
